title: Forklift Operator
experience: Previous experience as a Forklift Operator
description_text:
Our client is looking for a reliable and experienced Forklift Operator to join their team in Malta.
 The successful candidate will be responsible for the safe and efficient movement, loading, unloading, and storage of materials within the warehouse and operational areas.
 Key Responsibilities 
Operate forklifts safely and efficiently.
Load and unload deliveries and materials.
Move and organise stock within the warehouse.
Ensure materials are stored correctly and safely.
Assist with loading vehicles and preparing goods for dispatch.
Carry out basic checks on the forklift and report any issues.
Maintain a clean, organised, and safe working environment.
Follow all company health and safety procedures.
Support general warehouse duties when required.
 Requirements 
Previous experience as a Forklift Operator.
Valid forklift licence/certification.
Good understanding of warehouse and material-handling procedures.
Strong attention to safety and detail.
Reliable, responsible, and physically fit.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Previous experience in a warehouse or industrial environment will be considered an asset.
Must be based in Malta.
 What’s on Offer 
Full-time employment.
Competitive salary based on experience.
Stable working environment.
Opportunity to join an established and growing group.
 If you are an experienced Forklift Operator looking for a new opportunity in Malta, we would be happy to hear from you.
